card.fact_statement: The first sequence of the 2024 Summer Olympics opening ceremony was named Enchanté.
card.source_span: The first sequence, Enchanté (enchant/delight), accordionist Félicien Brut was sitting at the top of Pont d'Austerlitz

target_qa_variants.question: Wie hieß die erste Sequenz der Eröffnungsfeier der Olympischen Sommerspiele 2024?

target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'sequence' as 'Sequenz' and 'opening ceremony' as 'Eröffnungsfeier'. The sequence name 'Enchanté' remains unchanged.
